scope: 47 §4 exact AR identity and §5 fixed candidate workload arithmetic only
argument: A norm=1/2<1; independent equal-variance Gaussian innovations yield unique stationary Gaussian with diagonal equal covariance (4/3)*noise_variance. For one most-recent timestamp ordered own/other inputs have the same distribution, but conditional medians are +/-0.5*other. A single identity-blind function cannot equal both for nonzero other, which occurs almost surely. Additional identity/role features or different history schema are outside this counterexample.
limits: Logical example, not actual traffic evidence; no random samples or new model.
N(k+1) assumes one own and k separate candidate comparisons per cell, not a universal lower bound on all algorithms.
Runtime, repeated time blocks, candidate discovery, preprocessing, combinations and cache validity are not measured.
explicit_assumptions: Zero-mean Gaussian innovations with common variance sigma^2 > 0, independent across coordinates and time, independent of the past.
Stationary process, one most-recent timestamp only, ordered own/other inputs, a single function without cell identity or role distinction.
Unit-noise covariance is 4/3 I; general covariance is (4/3) sigma^2 I. Conditional medians differ in sign almost surely.
